purpose: Compose upstream intent, payee resolution, VoP/CoP, provider-JWS, participant limit/fee, payer presentation and consent evidence into a pre-initiation-only certificate.

source_register.title: Safety and efficiency through payment pre-validation
supports: Can reduce rejection, returns and manual intervention
Supports fraud mitigation and upfront cost transparency
does_not_support: Universal right to block a payer after mismatch

source_register.title: Verification of Payee Scheme Rulebook v1.1
supports: Provider-authoritative VoP result classes and participant roles

source_register.title: VoP payer warning after No Match or verification unavailable
supports: No Match or verification-not-possible is communicated with a warning
Payer decision remains distinct from provider result

source_register.title: Specific Direction 17: Confirmation of Payee expiry removed
supports: UK CoP direction remains in force beyond 1 November 2026
PSR reports over 320 organisations and over two million checks daily

source_register.title: Positioning the SARB's Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme
supports: NPU proposal includes future proxy resolution and confirmation-of-payee
Future baseline fraud protection is proposed
does_not_support: Operational participant endpoint or positive response

source_register.title: QR+ Standard 1.2
supports: QR+ supports QR, barcode and digital-link initiation data exchange
PayShap payload is initiation data; QR+ is not execution

source_register.title: Synthetic participant profile for evaluator fixtures
supports: Defines frozen test participant limit and fee inputs
does_not_support: Any real provider product, price, limit or authorisation
